scope: Independent source review of new real-input C4 Android probe plus narrow post-read deadline closure. No test execution or Android run by this reviewer.
source_checks: The CLI binds its actual file and CWD to the clean candidate checkout and checks both full published source SHAs; it retains the original APK signature/version/ABI/source/PCK verifier and hashes the installed base.apk before and after.
Actual SDK/release, explicit emulator serial, prior normal 21-step tour, native checkout and observed screen density are required. Existing 86445 Android outcomes cannot satisfy new C4 evidence.

Private-file reads use a fixed observation allowlist; the script does not write saves, requests or synthetic success. Actions use current exposed visible bounds and actual ADB touches/Home/normal launcher.
Owner/token/round/revision/ack/PID and settled layout are bound across state, layout, screenshot and subsequent rereads. A layout change before input rejects the touch.

The independent projector reconstructs all 42 known world cells and camera projection; native centers and quads must match within one pixel. Occupied cyan/gold discs are independently sampled at projected positions.
Touch targets must be enabled, visible and at least48dp in their actual exposed safe-area intersection; fixture insets are rejected in the Android path.

Two real child drops each require legal history, positive acknowledged sequence and a subsequent Dart bot turn. Native pause/resume, Home/inactive lifecycle, unchanged background save, normal Flutter return and new-token same-round reopen remain mandatory.
Original strict two-frame Flutter caption/foreground/native-process-return checks are reused. Original learning data and source/binary identities are checked at the end.

deadline_finding.problem: wait and snapshot could return a successful observation after the unchanged deadline when a final read itself ran long.
deadline_finding.closure: wait validates the same monotonic deadline after observe/accept. snapshot validates it after capture plus final state/layout/foreground/PID rereads, before publishing success. Both failures remain preserved and ultimately fail the existing bounded loop.

limits: No actual new C4 Android installation, device run, physical Fold7, FPS, heat or latency measurement has occurred in this review.

Pixel checks cover occupied discs; empty cells are reconstructed semantically/geometrically but are not each independently empty-pixel validated. The initial empty-board image alone produces no disc-pixel acceptance.
The original local v7 sidecar is a declared platform_fixture. Its1079x2400 image versus1080x2400 window mismatch is intentionally rejected by the Android contract, not silently accepted.
Two child/bot turns do not validate every bot strategy, all completed-game outcomes or real multi-child switches.
The local clock cases are synthetic observations of real helper methods; they are not emulator evidence. Original25-case freeze remains historical and unmodified.
